faq.question: How is this different from off-the-shelf SaaS?
faq.answer: Off-the-shelf SaaS optimizes for the average customer. A custom internal tool optimizes for your exact workflow — and you stop paying per seat as you grow. We recommend SaaS when it is the right answer, and a custom build when it is not.

faq.question: How long until my team can use it?
faq.answer: Our target is a usable first build in one to two weeks, with a feature-complete v1 in 6–10 weeks depending on integrations. We ship in weekly increments and demo every Friday.

faq.question: Will my team be able to maintain it?
faq.answer: Yes. We pick boring, well-documented stacks, write the README your future team will read, and run a handover sprint where we pair with whoever owns the tool day-to-day.

faq.question: What if the requirements change mid-build?
faq.answer: Expected. Our process is built around short feedback loops — weekly demos, shared roadmap, and a feature flag system that lets you turn changes on and off without redeploying.
